ignoreCommand: p=$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA;c=$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA;if [ -z "$p" ] || [ "$p" = "$c" ] || ! git cat-file -e "$p^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || ! git cat-file -e "$c^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi; git diff --quiet "$p" "$c" -- src package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.runtime.json Dockerfile.vercel vercel.json .dockerignore; status=$?; if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then exit 0; fi; exit 1
